f727e7c15e9ec1d7b3684e7596ed0f7591abf98e.sourceText: 不过需要真正访问对象时，仍然应该直接使用 `lock()` 并检查返回值。因为从调用 `expired()` 到调用 `lock()` 之间，对象的生命周期仍可能发生变化；`lock()` 能把“检查对象是否存在”和“临时取得所有权”合并为一次安全操作。
f727e7c15e9ec1d7b3684e7596ed0f7591abf98e.translatedText: However, when actual access to the object is needed, one should still directly use `lock()` and check the return value\. Because between the call to `expired()` and the call to `lock()` the object's lifetime may still change; `lock()` can combine "checking whether the object exists" and "temporarily acquiring ownership" into a single safe operation\.

f75364f910b83ebd920321e3dcf66729d932693d.sourceText: 所以，近处点密集的块可能很快更新，远处点少的块可能等到时间门槛，旧点保留超过0.2秒。没有新扫描时也不会单靠计时继续处理。`noDecayDis=0.0` 没有免衰减区域；以后调大，只让指定范围的自身历史绕过年龄检查，不会自动恢复近场缺失的输出。

When there is no new scan, processing will not continue based solely on the timer\.`noDecayDis=0.0`There is no decay\-free region; if increased later, it only allows the self\-history within a specified range to bypass the age check, and will not automatically restore the missing output in the near field\.
